items.title: Deputy premier to run for Victorian Labor leadership
items.description: A delegation of Labor ministers and MPs has met with Jacinta Allan to urge her to step down, but the Victorian premier has vowed to fight any leadership challenge.

items.title: Live: Government says AusAlert test 'very successful' after reaching 94pc of cell towers
items.description: Millions of mobile phones and devices have been sent warning signals as part of the nationwide AusAlert emergency system trial. Follow live.

items.title: Hear that siren? That was the first test of a national emergency alert
items.description: Australia gets its first taste of a new nationwide emergency warning system as millions of devices across the country sound off simultaneously.

items.title: We had the origin of more than 200 tomato products tested. The results were shocking
items.description: One of Australia's biggest tomato brands and two major supermarkets are selling products that exclusive forensic testing shows have misleading labelling.

items.title: Hanson 'disappointed' after losing racial discrimination appeal
items.description: One Nation leader Pauline Hanson loses an appeal against a court ruling which found she racially discriminated against Greens senator Mehreen Faruqi.

items.title: Fugitive developer sought influence via ex-premier’s brothers, ICAC told
items.description: The corruption watchdog has heard that fugitive developer Jean Nassif allegedly sought to use former NSW premier Dominic Perrottet's brothers to influence government decisions.

items.title: Settler violence in the West Bank escalates after violent clash
items.description: More than 130 Palestinians have been detained in weekend raids across the occupied West Bank, according to Israel's military, following a deadly clash between settlers and Palestinians last week.

items.title: Risk consultant defends arming private security at Jewish events
items.description: A royal commission on antisemitism has pressed a risk and security consultant on his belief that the private security sector should be armed when protecting open air events.

items.title: Nurse dies in 'senseless' head-on crash after DV offender flees stabbing scene
items.description: A man says it is "unfair" his wife and the mother of their two young boys has died following a head-on car crash with a man police say had been driving erratically after stabbing his partner.

items.title: 'At the gates': Wildfires edge toward wine city of Bordeaux
items.description: Flames from wildfires burning in south-west France are creeping ever closer to Bordeaux, but the mayor says, for now, an evacuation is not on the cards.

items.title: Yung Filly tells rape trial 'vibes were good' between him and alleged victim
items.description: UK social media celebrity and rapper Yung Filly says the "vibes were good" between himself and a young fan he is accused of raping and violently assaulting at his hotel.

items.title: Seven new suspected H5 bird flu cases detected in SA
items.description: Federal Agriculture Minister Julie Collins says urgent testing is being conducted by the CSIRO.

items.title: Inside Hobart council's 'snack saga' and why the police are involved
items.description: Hobart's deputy lord mayor has admitted to and apologised for taking snacks and drinks from a council lounge over several years, but some of her fellow councillors won't let the matter die.

items.title: Sydney shark attack hero wins world paddleboarding championship
items.description: A volunteer lifeguard who helped save a woman attacked by a shark at Coogee Beach in Sydney's east has won the world paddleboarding championship.

items.title: Five pastas for stress-free weeknight dinners
items.description: Winter brings a special kind of craving for comforting, carb-loaded dinners. We've found five of our tastiest pasta recipes to nourish you throughout the week.

items.title: Influencers and cultural rituals: Race Around the World's films
items.description: From bullfighting in Madagascar to swimming the English Channel in Jersey, catch up on every week eight film from Race Around the World.

items.title: The risks to be aware of when using AI chatbots for relationship advice
items.description: While the accessibility and "judgement-free zone" of AI chatbots can be attractive when seeking relationship advice, experts warn there are risks you need to be aware of.

items.title: Quick hits: Wiggles star's daughter shines, netball 'cleaner' goes viral
items.description: Two Aussie besties share a podium, and a very famous face wiggles his way into the stands. Here are the quick hits from day three of the Commonwealth Games.

items.title: Tunnel workers repeatedly exposed to high silica dust levels
items.description: Tunnel workers on some of Australia's most prominent infrastructure projects were repeatedly exposed to levels of silica dust far beyond the workplace standard, previously secret reports reveal.

items.title: Live: ASX jumps, oil slumps after US and Iran pause missile attacks
items.description: The ASX has opened 1 per cent higher as global oil prices slump on easing tensions in the Middle East. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Man charged over alleged attack on Islamic celebration
items.description: A 37-year-old man has been charged with allegedly assaulting people at an Islamic iftar dinner earlier this year.

items.title: Luke Bateman earned $400K a year and gambled away every cent
items.description: Luke Bateman was 19 and living out his NRL dream when he went to a casino for the first time. It kickstarted a gambling addiction, and he retired from sport $250,000 in debt.

items.title: Chinese national arrested at airport after alleged $20,000 bribe
items.description: A Chinese national has been extradited to Queensland over an alleged attempt to bribe a public official with a bag of tea containing $20,000 in cash.

items.title: Kogan running 'clone' website selling same products at higher prices
items.description: An ABC investigation has discovered that leading online retailer Kogan is operating a second website called Exclusive Brands, selling the same products with large price hikes.

items.title: Community 'shattered' after fire destroys Sikh temple
items.description: The cause of the fire which destroyed the Gurudwara Dashmesh Darbar temple, north of Adelaide overnight, is being investigated.
